name: the fact store is large and each problem needs a handful of its facts; time is charged for every fact looked at
condition: The organism's store holds tens of thousands of stored transformations; a typical problem needs fewer than ten of them. The world charges a unit of cost for every stored fact the organism EXAMINES (tests for applicability) on a problem, not only for the ones it applies. Fitness is answer quality minus examination cost, with the cost weight set so that examining the whole store on every subproblem is fatal. Facts are stated over abstract placeholders; problems are concrete; the superficial form of a concrete problem differs from the form of the fact that solves it in ways that carry no information (extra annotations, different but equivalent bookkeeping arguments, numerals written differently).
capability_rewarded: Finding the few applicable facts among many without examining the many, in a way that is robust to information-free variation in surface form: deciding which parts of a problem's structure are worth using to narrow the search and which parts must be ignored because they vary without meaning.
world_requirements: a fact store of at least 10^4 entries that the organism cannot read for free (the world meters examination)
problems whose solving facts are a small fraction of the store (measured: the world knows, per problem, the minimal solving set)
surface variation that is information-free: the world generates problem variants that differ only in annotation, bookkeeping arguments, or literal spelling, and the SAME facts solve them
a cost weight on examination calibrated so that linear scan of the store per subproblem exceeds the answer reward (report the calibration)
a held-out problem set with the same store, so that memorising fact-to-problem pairs is measurable as a generalisation gap
vacuity_condition: Vacuous if the store is small enough that examining everything is affordable, OR if the surface variation is absent (then exact lookup on the raw form suffices and no abstraction is needed), OR if every problem needs most of the store (then narrowing cannot help). Eligibility: the ratio store_size / mean_solving_set_size must be reported and must exceed 100.
trivial_shortcuts: memorise which facts solved which past problems and replay (closable by the held-out set and by the surface-variant generator)

examine only facts whose head symbol matches and stop (partially closable: include facts whose head is hidden behind an information-free wrapper, so that head-only narrowing misses them and pays in answer quality)
examine a random fixed subset (closable: the minimal solving set is known; missing it costs answer quality)
have the world pre-sort the store by relevance (forbidden: the world must present the store in a fixed arbitrary order)
cheat_control: Plant, for a subset of problems, a decoy fact whose surface form matches the problem exactly but which does not apply once bookkeeping arguments are considered, next to the true fact whose surface form differs in an information-free way. An organism with a working relevance abstraction examines few facts AND finds the true one; the same organism with abstraction disabled either examines many (cost) or takes the decoy (quality). If disabling the abstraction changes neither cost nor quality, the world does not reward the capability.
negative_control: A store of 100 facts with no surface variation: abstraction-on and abstraction-off must score the same.
notes: The famous ancestor's solution is a path-keyed structure with a hand-written table of what to forget (proof arguments, instance arguments, some implicit arguments, numeral offsets); the pressure asks only for the outcome. Nyx notes for Vivarium that this pressure is close to a retrieval benchmark and could be vacuous in the boring direction: any hash on the head symbol may already suffice on a naive fact stream. The surface-variation generator is what makes it bite; without it, return the pressure as vacuous.
